firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose who places first: that player puts their robot and Archive marker on Dock 1. The other players place clockwise on the remaining docks.
clarifications: This chooses starting dock assignments. Players program their robots together; during execution, a higher Program-card priority number moves before a lower one when order matters.
